title: Apollo 14 blue orb above Mitchell blacked out in LPI scan

tellings.quote: there is a blue orb in the lunar sky very clearly. It's very obvious above uh Mitchell.

plain: A photo from the 1971 Apollo 14 moon landing shows a blue ball of light hanging in the lunar sky above the astronaut Edgar Mitchell, and in one archive copy that spot is said to be blacked out. A researcher named Maaneli Derakhshani makes the claim on the show without naming a source. He says the orb is "very obvious above uh Mitchell" in the version kept by a second archive, while the scan held by the Lunar and Planetary Institute, a US science archive of moon images, hides it. He also mentions the journalist Ross Coulthart. If true, it would mean something unexplained was photographed on the moon and later covered up.
